# TinyDoc

> TinyDoc is an open-source Python engine that turns receipt and invoice images into schema-validated JSON with exact OCR-span evidence and per-field confidence. It runs local Qwen2.5-VL-3B or Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct models through Ollama. It is not a TinyDoc-trained checkpoint.

## Key facts

- Package: `pip install tinydoc` (0.2.0), Apache 2.0, Python 3.10+.
- Readers: `qwen2.5vl:3b` (quality) and `qwen3-vl:2b-instruct` (fast); both Apache 2.0.
- Output: JSON Schema-valid fields, per-field quote/page/bbox evidence, confidence, optional overlay PNG.
- Runtime: local Ollama. No API key, no cloud, no telemetry.
- Receipts: 0.9475 field F1 (3B) and 0.9200 (2B) on SROIE clean-100 — public train split, duplicate-filtered, not an external benchmark; 60% of the original set is leaked.
- Invoices: 91.9% key-header / 65.7% fully correct (3B) and 93.5% / 71.8% (2B) on a synthetic 181-document, page-1-only benchmark. Not real supplier invoices.
- Evidence coverage: 0.798 of non-empty fields. Grounding is OCR spans; VLM-predicted boxes failed the 0.70 gate (hit@0.5 0.04–0.20).
- Confidence: field-level ECE 0.115–0.135 raw, 0.005–0.014 after document-grouped isotonic out-of-fold. Document-level confidence is not calibrated. Use for review routing, not as a probability.
- Not measured: real supplier invoices, DocVQA, full multipage PDFs. Flagging fails (0/7).

## Short answers

- What is TinyDoc? A local-first extraction SDK and CLI for receipts and invoices, with cited output.
- Does it ship a model? No. It uses third-party Qwen VLMs and adds the extraction and trust layer.
- Does it need the cloud? No. Inference runs on a local Ollama server.
- Is it production-ready? It is a developer preview. Real invoices and multipage PDFs are unmeasured; flagging fails.
- Is the confidence a probability? No. Field scores are for review routing; document scores are not calibrated.
- Does it predict boxes? It returns OCR-span boxes as provenance. Model-predicted boxes did not meet the gate.
- How accurate is it? 0.9475 receipt F1 (3B) on SROIE clean-100; 91.9%/65.7% invoice key-header/fully-correct (3B) on a synthetic page-1 probe.
- What is planned? DocVQA wiring, full multipage rendering, a dedicated calibration split, and real-invoice evaluation.

## Citation
